description: This file contains benchmark tests for scrolling within the interests topic list of the Now in Android app. It uses Android's benchmark macro and UI Automator to measure scroll performance under different compilation modes.

classes.name: ScrollTopicListBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark test class for measuring scrolling performance in the interests topic list of the app.

methods.name: benchmarkStateChangeCompilationBaselineProfile
methods.description: Runs the benchmark with a partial compilation mode to measure performance.

methods.name: benchmarkStateChange
methods.description: Performs the repeated scroll measurement under specified compilation mode.
